items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Where, where was he from? I don't know.

ctx.x: I'm going to look at that record. I have a record here. And she was dying over. But her husband said, oh, Mrs. Senegal, don't rush her. Don't push her with this. Because I need her with these children. More than that, you know? So I, you know, she'd write to me. And mother, do this, write to the, I wouldn't. I said, no. She was, needed more at home with her children than this town. Yeah. But if she had tech on. Now she wrote to New York. And New York, her company wanted to take her, take her poems, you know, her…
Well, I wanted to ask you about Billy Kersan. How did he happen to come to Donaldson's then?
Where, where was he from? I don't know.
